governance.note: Migration of nyiso-34 (st-tempfloor keeper) from legacy per-ISO hardcoded CT/ST reliability floors to the unified registry-driven reliability-floor engine (--reliability-floor, reliability_floor_coeffs_NYISO.csv, transmission.inject_reliability_floor). CSV adjusted to reproduce the legacy persistent-base behaviour: NYC and Long_Island ST_GAS limbs set to driver=tmax threshold=-50 (always-on) with floor_pct matching the legacy base_24h (when-available cool-day CF p25: NYC 0.391, LI 0.289), distribution=pro_rata. CC_REGULAR and CC_CHP limbs disabled (not in keeper-34's legacy floors). Retains every structural overlay: nyiso_local_selfsupply (Long Island 45%), nyiso_firm_imports (HQ hydro must-flow), nyiso_import_reconciliation (monthly EIA-930 band), energy_reserve_coopt (locational nested RCPF with NYCA/East/SENY/NYC tiers). GROUNDING: the persistent-base floor_pct values are the legacy base_24h cool-day when-available CF p25 from scripts/derive_nyiso_st_reliability_floor.py (CAMPD 2023-2025 pooled regression, archived data/raw/nyiso-weather/nyiso_zone_tmax_daily.csv). These are measured physical inputs (in-city reliability commitment baseline) that pass the admissibility test (CLAUDE.md #12): producible for a forward year from the fleet's when-available CF distribution. The hot-day Capital_Hudson ST_GAS and NYC CT_PEAKER limbs retain the unified engine's structural commit_frac x min_stable_pct methodology.

_migration_note: Unified reliability-floor engine migration v2. The v1 run (hot-day-only gating, commit_frac x min_stable_pct floor levels) regressed C1 fuel-mix because the unified engine's floor methodology does not include the legacy's persistent 24h base — it only fires on extreme-temperature days. Fixed by converting NYC and LI ST_GAS limbs to always-on persistent bases with the legacy base_24h floor levels. CC/CHP limbs disabled to match keeper-34 scope.

exceptions.metric: C3a system load-weighted mean LMP vs actual RT
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED (rule-#1 tradeoff; min-gen floor + reserve-scarcity frontier)
